report.clinical_summary: The patient has CLL and is on Venetoclax 400mg daily with good adherence. They experience persistent fatigue, recurrent bacterial infections (4-5/year), lymphadenopathy (neck, axillary, groin), and new severe persistent headaches. Bloodwork was normal last month. They've had to start taking afternoon naps most days to function, and simple tasks now require 'monumental efforts.' The patient describes infections as an 'ongoing battle' and expresses frustration and tiredness. They are proactive about communicating with their oncologist and will discuss these symptoms at their next follow-up.
